name: BBQ Pork Chop with Corn on the Cob & Creamy Broccoli Slaw

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, remove husks and silks from corn; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season both sides with salt and pepper, then coat with BBQ sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, bone-in
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ cup barbecue sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with butter; working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and coat with additional BBQ sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
⅓ cup barbecue sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, uncover the pot and reduce heat to medium; use tongs to lower the corn into the water and cook until just tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry parsley, then shave leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a large bowl along with dressing and mayo; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
¼ cup honey mustard dressing
2 tbsp mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to the bowl with dressing and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pork chops, corn, and slaw between plates; spread corn with butter and sprinkle with salt. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp salt
